snippet.title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2026 Announcement Trailer | Demo Out Now!
snippet.description:
The moment you’ve all been waiting for is finally here! 🚗🔥

Car Mechanic Simulator 2026 has been officially announced - and to celebrate, the Single Player Demo is live right now! 🔧

Build, repair, and expand your automotive empire like never before, now with co-op gameplay. Team up with friends and run your own workshop together for the first time in the series.

Wishlist the full game and jump into the Single Player Demo today! 🚀
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2692660/Car_Mechanic_Simulator_2026
